metadata.species: Neutropenic female ICR mice about 25 g; made renally impaired with uranyl nitrate; mouse thigh infection involving E. coli and K. pneumoniae isolates, with ESBL and non-ESBL isolates. ATCC 25922 is also listed. Binding is assumed for mice and humans.
metadata.matrix: Serum for supporting PK; MIC testing medium and binding measurement matrix NOT_FOUND.
metadata.exposure_basis: Reported Meropenem fT>MIC (%) and Ertapenem fT>MIC (%) in mice; Protein binding 8% assumed for mice and humans. Direct unbound concentrations NOT_FOUND.
metadata.record_level: Per-isolate MIC summaries, described as median of >=3 MIC experiments, and source-reported per-isolate fT>MIC percentages; assumed binding and study-design notes. No individual-animal concentration or CFU records are supplied.
metadata.route: Meropenem s.c.; Ertapenem route NOT_FOUND. Cyclophosphamide and uranyl nitrate i.p. are animal-preparation treatments.
metadata.endpoint_window: Treatment from 2 h after inoculation; meropenem regimen repeated every 8 h over 24 h; thighs harvested at 24 h. The denominator window for reported fT>MIC (%) is NOT_FOUND.
metadata.dosing_regimen: Meropenem 65, 30, 20, 5 mg/kg s.c. (0.2 ml) at 0, 1.5, 3, 5 h, repeated every 8 h over 24 h, to mimic human 1 g q8h (Fig. 1 legend says 60/30/20/5); groups of 3 mice; thighs harvested at 24 h. Ertapenem comparator regimen 50 mg/kg q6h.

source_table.notes:
MICs and fT>MIC of ESBL and non-ESBL isolates, humanized regimen in mouse thigh
S05 | DOI 10.1128/aac.00752-06 | Table 1 (DeRyke et al. 2007)
Neutropenic female ICR mice about 25 g (cyclophosphamide 150 mg/kg day -4 and 100 mg/kg day -1 i.p.) made renally impaired with uranyl nitrate 5 mg/kg i.p. 3 days before inoculation. Thigh inoculum about 10^5 CFU/ml standard (10^7 CFU/ml high inoculum for three isolates); treatment from 2 h after inoculation.
Meropenem 65, 30, 20, 5 mg/kg s.c. (0.2 ml) at 0, 1.5, 3, 5 h, repeated every 8 h over 24 h, to mimic human 1 g q8h (Fig. 1 legend says 60/30/20/5); groups of 3 mice; thighs harvested at 24 h. Ertapenem comparator regimen 50 mg/kg q6h. Serum PK by HPLC; sampling times and n per time not stated.
Protein binding 8% assumed for mice and humans. Footnotes: a median of >=3 MIC experiments; b fT>MIC in mice; c non-ESBL isolate; d removed from analysis (no infection established); e difference between meropenem and ertapenem efficacies.
Ertapenem columns are a comparator drug. Per-isolate CFU changes are in Fig. 3 only (not transcribed). Non-doubling MICs (e.g. 0.047) printed as is.
